name: applytrack
description: ApplyTrack - job application tracker (Phase 1: foundation and authentication)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix client run lint
scripts.audit: npm --prefix server audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm --prefix client audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high
scripts.audit:all: npm --prefix server audit && npm --prefix client audit
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
